_comment: BrightAI — Vercel hardening configuration (2026-07-07, rev 2: CORS + CSP fixes)

_design.scope: Security headers + CORS scoped to /api/* only. NO CORS constraints on regular pages.
_design.cors_strategy: Access-Control-Allow-Origin restricted to the canonical BrightAI domain https://brightai.site ONLY for /api/* routes. Static pages are not affected. NOTE: no /api/* folder exists in this Astro project — API runs separately at brightai-api.onrender.com. The CORS block is kept for future serverless routes.
_design.csp_strategy: Phase 2 (this deploy): removed `unsafe-inline` from script-src and script-src-elem. Analytics (gtag + Clarity + SW register) externalized to /js/*.js with defer. Remaining inline scripts are Astro-bundled (auto-generated module scripts in every layout/page) — each is whitelisted via explicit sha256-* hash. JSON-LD blocks (type=application/ld+json) are not executable JavaScript and are not covered by script-src. Phase 3 (next): nonce-based CSP via Astro middleware.
_design.hsts_strategy: max-age=63072000 (2 years) per request. includeSubDomains; preload. Preload submission via https://hstspreload.org is a manual one-time action after this deploy.
_design.inline_hash_source: Computed via `python3 -c "import hashlib,base64; print('\'sha256-' + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(open(...).read().encode()).digest()).decode() + '\'')"` against every inline <script> body in dist/*.html after `npm run build`. Hashes are stable as long as the source files are not modified. Any new inline script must be added to this list before deploy, or it will be blocked by CSP.
pending_items: STYLE-001: style-src and style-src-elem still allow 'unsafe-inline'. Astro emits inline <style> blocks for scoped component CSS and critical font-face. Phase 3: hash-based style whitelisting (same pattern as scripts). Tracked but NOT fixed in this deploy to limit blast radius.

SCRIPT-001: 27 unique inline script hashes. If any Astro component or layout file is edited that contains an inline script, the affected hash(es) must be re-computed and this list updated before deploy.
API-001: /api/* CORS is configured but no /api/* folder exists yet. When API routes are added, validate the CORS origin against the actual call sites.
